item.title: India's oilmeal exports fall 28.5% as soymeal loses to Brazil, Argentina
item.description: India's exports of oilmeals, mainly used as animal feed, fell 28.51 per cent in the April-August period of the current fiscal year to 12.82 lakh tonne, as a slump in soybean meal sales weighed on shipments, an industry body said on Monday. Exports were 17.93 lakh tonnes in the same period a year earlier, the Solvent Extractors' Association of India (SEA) said. Total oilmeal exports in the 2025-26 fiscal year stood at 37.68 lakh tonnes. Soybean meal exports plunged 73 per cent to 2,05,000 tonnes from 7,57,000 tonnes a year earlier. "Indian soybean meal has faced severe pricing pressure in international markets during August 2026, trading around USD 622 per tonne compared to global benchmarks near USD 445 per tonne," the SEA said in a statement. Cheaper supplies from South American producers such as Argentina and Brazil continue to capture major market share, it added. item.title: India opens deepwater oil, gas bids, offers to fund up to 50% of well costs
item.description: The government is rolling out a special licensing round for deepwater and ultra-deepwater oil and gas blocks, offering monthly bidding windows and relaxed fiscal terms as it prepares to shoulder up to 50 per cent of eligible exploratory well costs under its Rs 84,084-crore Samudra Manthan offshore exploration programme. The special round under the Open Acreage Licensing Policy (OALP) is aimed at accelerating exploration in India's offshore frontier basins by lowering entry barriers, sharing the high costs and risks of deepwater drilling, and making acreage available to investors throughout the year. "Under the government's 'Samudra Manthan' National Offshore Exploration Scheme, a Special OALP is being introduced for fast-track award of deepwater and ultra-deepwater (DW/UDW) exploration blocks," the Directorate General of Hydrocarbons (DGH) said in a notice. DGH said details of the bid round will be announced shortly. The Special OALP is a key licensing and investment facilitation .
